exam.title: CLP C Certified Professional Programmer
exam.study_prerequisites: No formal prerequisite is published, but CLA or equivalent experience is recommended. Practice advanced C in explicitly labeled language and platform contexts across language evolution, variadic calls, POSIX/Windows low-level I/O, allocation and strings, C11 threads, floating-point behavior, sockets, volatile, non-local jumps, undefined behavior and complex declarations. Use multiple toolchains and diagnostic tools where practical.

review.notes: All 30 CLP-12-01 objectives are mapped through C language evolution and historical constructs, variadic calls, POSIX/Windows/API/ABI distinctions, low-level I/O, memory/string/sort/search behavior, processes/threads and C11 synchronization, numerical behavior, socket framing/serialization, volatile, non-local jumps, undefined behavior and complex declarations. Three scenarios, eight labs and 30 original checks are included. Portable ISO C is explicitly separated from POSIX, Windows, compiler and external-library contracts. SEI and O'Reilly are automation-blocked; no link is missing. No recalled/live item, answer dump or copied course question is used. September 17, 2026 link-only maintenance: the SEI reference moved to the official cmu-sei.github.io site and is reachable; link counts were refreshed. This does not represent a new full-content or practitioner review. September 29 CPE source-health refresh updated shared-link counts only; this guide content and review date were not re-reviewed.

findings.title: Professional scope needs explicit objective mapping
findings.evidence: The active CLP-12-01 syllabus has 29 numbered objectives in eight blocks.
findings.recommendation: Map all 29 objectives; retain 55 items, weights and normalized score; distinguish edition and platform contracts.
findings.resolution: Map all 29 objectives; retain 55 items, weights and normalized score; distinguish edition and platform contracts.

findings.title: Variadic fragment omits a required type declaration and contract guards
findings.evidence: A reduced original header/signature reproducer rejects undeclared size_t; count alone cannot check argument types.
findings.recommendation: Provide complete original mean and va_copy formatting with headers, finite bounds, cleanup and truncation checks; never run mismatched calls.
findings.resolution: Provide complete original mean and va_copy formatting with headers, finite bounds, cleanup and truncation checks; never run mismatched calls.

findings.title: Stack-only variadic intuition does not generalize
findings.evidence: Microsoft x64 uses positional registers and shadow space; variadic FP duplication is ABI-specific.
findings.recommendation: Teach API, ABI and language boundaries; use va_list rather than guessed stack addresses.
findings.resolution: Teach API, ABI and language boundaries; use va_list rather than guessed stack addresses.

findings.title: Empty descriptor error handlers do not establish ownership
findings.evidence: The prior fragment continues after failed open; Linux and POSIX2024 close interruption rules differ.
findings.recommendation: Provide an exclusive fixture, checked progress and cleanup, with an explicit Linux no-retry close policy.
findings.resolution: Provide an exclusive fixture, checked progress and cleanup, with an explicit Linux no-retry close policy.

findings.title: Condition signals require predicate and synchronization reasoning
findings.evidence: Resolved C17 DR480 permits unspecified wakeups and rejects signal-only publication assumptions.
findings.recommendation: Implement mutex-protected predicates, draining shutdown and join before reading totals or destruction; record ThreadSanitizer limits.
findings.resolution: Implement mutex-protected predicates, draining shutdown and join before reading totals or destruction; record ThreadSanitizer limits.

findings.title: Multiple precision needs a concrete library lifetime contract
findings.evidence: Assigned rationals may be noncanonical; exact integer/fraction arithmetic differs from bounded floating arithmetic.
findings.recommendation: Initialize and clear GMP objects, canonicalize 2/20 and verify 2^100 and 3/10 alongside compensated accumulation.
findings.resolution: Initialize and clear GMP objects, canonicalize 2/20 and verify 2^100 and 3/10 alongside compensated accumulation.

findings.title: Receive zero must be interpreted with request and transport type
findings.evidence: Positive-length stream EOF differs from zero-count requests and empty datagrams.
findings.recommendation: Provide a bounded frame decoder that preserves outputs on failure; test empty frames, truncation, oversize, reversed headers and adjacent frames.
findings.resolution: Provide a bounded frame decoder that preserves outputs on failure; test empty frames, truncation, oversize, reversed headers and adjacent frames.

findings.evidence: Indexed issuer badge criteria list CLA and CLP, but the canonical exam page has no formal prerequisite. Appointment-window copy also conflicts.
